A small lending library needs only three tables. A loan ties one member to one copy, so a book with several copies can be out to several members at once.

```mermaid
erDiagram
  MEMBER ||--o{ LOAN : borrows
  COPY ||--o{ LOAN : "is lent in"
  BOOK ||--|{ COPY : "has"
  MEMBER {
    int id PK
    string name
    date joined
  }
  BOOK {
    int id PK
    string title
    string isbn
  }
  COPY {
    int id PK
    int book_id FK
    string shelf
  }
  LOAN {
    int id PK
    int member_id FK
    int copy_id FK
    date due
  }
```

Keep `due` on the loan rather than the copy: it belongs to one lending, and the history of past loans stays intact.
